decisions.rationale: 6 days in with zero product progress (no first project, no invite, no key milestone) and no reply to the welcome email [email:082d9dc7]; no tickets, so no engagement signal at all. Silent, inactive new accounts rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: A simple first step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

Checking in now that your first week with Wrenfield is underway. If it helps, the easiest place to start is one project with a few real tasks \u2014 projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and you can invite a teammate from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything about how North Labs wants to organize its work.

Best,
Nadia
